platform: HEXAGON HQ Trackstack House and Bass House Demo Route
manual_review_reason: HEXAGON HQ explicitly opens demos through an embedded Trackstack workflow and is looking for House, Bass House and Club Bangers. The complete runtime fields, file limits, declarations, session state and any challenge controls are not exposed in the static page. A human must confirm track fit, final-master status, originality, rights, metadata and the live Trackstack form before upload.

platform: Future House Cloud SubmitHub Playlist Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Future House Cloud explicitly forbids track submissions through its contact form and routes them to its official SubmitHub playlister page. A human must use an owner-controlled SubmitHub account, review free versus premium-credit options, confirm curator fit, track rights, metadata and release status, and complete any session or platform controls. Do not use the general contact form or copyright address for music submissions.

platform: Dharma Worldwide Basic and Pro Demo Drop Route
manual_review_reason: The official Dharma demo portal requires sign-in and an MP3 upload. Basic submissions are listened to without guaranteed feedback, while paid Pro membership offers guaranteed feedback. A human must review account ownership, free-versus-Pro choice, master and rights status, metadata, label fit, terms and any live session controls before upload or subscription.

platform: Kannibalen Records Public Label Intake Routing Inquiry
manual_review_reason: Kannibalen publishes label@kannibalenrecords.com for General Inquiries but does not publish complete unsolicited-demo delivery rules. Queue only a short asset-free inquiry asking whether demos are open and which authorized route and format to use. A human must approve the inquiry copy and must not attach audio, send track links or repurpose the separate press or sync addresses.

platform: Mixmash Records Human-Verification Demo Routing Inquiry Form
manual_review_reason: Mixmash publishes an official contact form but no complete current unsolicited-demo policy on the public page. The form includes a visual code that must be copied, so it is a human-verification boundary. Queue only an asset-free routing inquiry asking whether demos are open and which authorized route to use. A human must inspect the live fields, complete verification and approve the message; no music file or track link should be supplied through this inquiry unless Mixmash explicitly instructs it.
